subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should this PR permanently reset the question and session-catalog protocol/SDK contracts for beta consumers before public npm publication, or preserve a deprecation path for any released external consumers?
rationale: The correct answer depends on maintainer-owned release and external-consumer commitments; the author’s audit assertion is not a substitute for an explicit public contract decision.

options.title: Accept the beta reset
options.body: Confirm that no released external consumer requires the removed names or nested answer shape, record that audit in the PR, and land the new canonical contract.

options.title: Preserve a deprecation bridge
options.body: Retain the released SDK/wire names with a documented migration period if any shipped plugin or client is still entitled to depend on them.

options.title: Split the publication cleanup
options.body: Land only non-breaking dead-surface and metadata work now, and defer protocol reshapes until the consumer boundary is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the beta reset
recommendation.body: Confirm that no released external consumer requires the removed names or nested answer shape, record that audit in the PR, and land the new canonical contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows sustained ownership of the protocol cleanup and its generated-client follow-through; a separate maintainer must still confirm release policy.
